nodes.title: An evaluation's call record is lost end-to-end for the judgment-failure outcome
nodes.summary: The single corrective task that carries usage, elapsed_ms and prompt from a completed evaluator call through judgmentFailureEvaluation and into the persisted and read-back evaluation record.

nodes.title: A judgment-failure evaluation carries its own call record, in memory and persisted
nodes.summary: Makes judgmentFailureEvaluation fold the completed (rejected) call's usage/elapsed_ms/prompt into the returned evaluation, and widens the investigation_evaluations table plus its read/write mapping to carry those same three fields for any evaluation, present exactly when a call ran.
